strings.subtitle: — File tihchhiatna —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Hruai leh tlak loh a awm lo. A hnuaia button hi hmang rawh.
strings.shred_button: T I H C H H I A T
strings.ssd_warning:
Vaukhanna! SSD-ah TRIM avangin chunga ziahna method hian tihchhiat a tiam lo.
He program hi HDD tan a ni.
strings.confirm_text:
File "{name}" chu chunga ziahin tihchhiat a ni ang.

Kalpui?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Hei hi shortcut (.lnk) a ni. Shortcut hi chauh tiboral a ni ang.

A target file a la awm reng ang.

Chhun zel?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Hei hi network drive (\\server\share) a ni.
Sector overwrite hian tiboral a tiam lo — server-in snapshot, deduplication emaw CoW a nei thei.

Chhun zel?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Hei hi removable drive (USB / HDD pawn lam) a ni.
Controller-in block hlui a dah that thei.

Chhun zel?
strings.error_cannot_read:
File chhiar theih a ni lo:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  FILE CHUNGA ZIAHIN TIHCHHIAT A NI
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS chher chhuah danga data stream (ADS) hi thawk a ni lo.
• USN journal hi tihthianghlim a ni lo.
• Shadow copy leh cloud sync
  (OneDrive leh dang) hi nghawng a nei lo.
strings.status_full: Chhunga thil awm zawng zawng zero-in chunga ziah a ni. Tihkir leh theih a ni lo — hmanruate chuan zero chauh an hmu ang.
strings.status_fast: Lu, mei leh 4 MB phat chunga ziah a ni. A bang la tih a ni lo, mahse kua avangin hmanrua pangngaia tihkir leh kim theih a ni lo. Lehkha thurûk tan HLAWH mode hmang rawh.
strings.status_empty: File a ruak, chunga ziah a ngai lo. Tihchhiat a ni.
strings.error_permission: File hi belh theih a ni lo. Program dangah hawng a ni thei. Hawntir la, leh rawh.
strings.error_not_found: File hmuh a ni lo. Tihboral tawh a ni thei.
strings.error_is_symlink: Hei hi symbolic link a ni. Link hi tiboral theih a ni lo — target file a la awm reng ang.
strings.error_reparse: Hei hi placeholder file (OneDrive emaw a ang) a ni. A data hi cloud-ah a awm, disk-ah a awm lo — hetah hian tiboral tur a awm lo.
strings.error_not_file: Hei hi file a ni lo (folder emaw thil dang). File dah rawh.
strings.error_hardlinks: He file hian hard link dang a nei ({n} a vai). Hard link-ah chuan a lal a awm lo — hming zawng zawng an inza. Tuna kawnga i tihboral chuan, data te hi overwrite a niang a, 32 bytes-ah tihai a ni ang, mahse a hmawr te hi link dang atanga lut theih a la ni ang. Link zawng zawng hmasa phawt rawh.
strings.error_compressed:
File hi compress, encrypt emaw sparse a ni. Zero overwrite hian data hlui tiboral a tiam lo, NTFS-in a dana a dah that vangin.

Attribute paih rawh: dinglam click → Properties → Advanced → 'Compress' leh/emaw 'Encrypt' tik loh rawh. Tin, SHREDDER run leh rawh.
strings.queue_hint: (emaw file te hi window ah hruai rawh)
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ File awm mek hnuah chawh a ni ang...
strings.queue_paused: ⏸ Chawh lawk a ni. «CHHUN ZEL» hmet rawh.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
File {count} hi tiboral a ni ang.
A vai zawng zawng: {size}.

Chhun zel hmain list hi en rawh.
He thil hi a lo let leh theih loh.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Queue atang hian file {count} zawng zawng paih bo vek tur? 

File te hi an la awm ang — list chauh a bo ang.
strings.hardlink_text:
File "{name}" hian hard link dang a nei ({nlink} a vai).

Data te hi hming zawng zawng atan tiboral a ni ang.
Mahse a hmawr (32 bytes) te hi folder chhunga hming dang hnuaiah a la awm ang.

He hmawr te hi kut ngeia i thiat a ngai mai thei.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Queue chhunga hard link zawng zawngah hmang rawh
